traffic_zh: 白領上班族為主，午市尖峰翻檯率極高
traffic_en: Mainly corporate white-collars; high lunch turnover rate
strategy_zh: 白領控醣需求高，建議推動小份量出餐與少飯扣減優惠。
strategy_en: High low-carb demand; promote smaller servings and Less Rice discounts.

traffic_zh: 家庭客、長者與週末休閒客群
column14: 家庭用餐與兒童共享比例高，建議推動彈性配菜組合。
column15: High family sharing ratio; promote flexible side dish combos.

traffic_zh: 學生、教職員，運動量及食量顯著較大
traffic_en: Students and faculty with active appetite
strategy_zh: 維持大份量以維持飽足感，重點監控肉類醬汁口味與炸物品質。
strategy_en: Maintain large portions; monitor protein tenderness and gravy quality.

traffic_zh: 家庭客及換乘鐵路客流
strategy_zh: 重點監控主食及焗烤類餐點份量。
strategy_en: Focus on portion control for rice and baked pasta entrees.
